narrative: The roll opened just below the turned head. The name is still hidden. A cue mark in the margin, no word added beside it. No face. The same thumb. Paint at the nail. He does not write a name in the margin. The rope is a blur at the bench. No face. The roll under his hand, closed. He is still seated. The door behind him is shut. No face.
